newsitem.title: FRANCE: Brokers set 1,000 Ffr target for Alcatel.
newsitem.headline: Brokers set 1,000 Ffr target for Alcatel.

text.p: Various brokers have raised their forecasts and share price targets and upped recommendations for telecommunications group Alcatel Alsthom, fund managers said on Friday.
Some analysts have set share price targets above 1,000 francs, they added.
The upgrades followed Alcatel's announcement of first-half sales figures which showed a rise of 17 percent and a sharp recovery in telecommunications.

DB Bourse, which held the stock at neutral but raised its earnings per share forecast, set a target of 1,050 francs per share, which will give it a valuation on a par with its main European competitors. It raised the EPS forecast by seven francs to 32.40 francs for 1997 and by eight to 44.50 for 1998.
Cheuvreux de Virieu held it at a 1 rating, holding it on its stock pick list, and set a target above 1,000 francs for the share price.
Ferri called the turnover figures "excellent" and raised its share target to 1,000 which represented a valuation one times turnover.

SGE Delahaye rated the stock at outperform, upped its share target to 940/950 francs. It held the EPS forecatsts at 34 francs for 1997 and 51.10 for 1998 but raised it by five percent to 60.98 for 1999, citing a dynamic medium-term outlook for telecommunications.
Transbourse upped its rating to buy from hold and Paribas Capital Capital Markets rated it a buy, up from neutral.
